name: Tsukushite Agechau 5 ~Motomeru Otome-tachi~
original_name: 尽くしてあげちゃう5～求める乙女たち～
source:
Main character attends a boys school and worries about his lack of communication experience with girls. He looses a bet and infiltrates a girls school with a camera. He is chased and beaten by the guard, but is saved by girls in the dormitory. The four girls tend his bruises and are very kind to him. They kiss among themselves, but explain it as a greeting sign rather than expression of lesbian affection. Protagonist wants to be greeted in the same manner. He soon finds himself in love relations with all the four girls.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角就读于男子学校，担心自己缺乏与女孩的沟通经验。他打赌输了，带着相机潜入女子学校。被门卫追打，被宿舍女生救下。四个女孩帮他处理瘀伤，对他非常友善。她们互相接吻，但将其解释为一种问候信号，而不是表达女同性恋的感情。主角希望以同样的方式受到欢迎。他很快发现自己与所有四个女孩都陷入了爱情关系。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
